src/acl-store.ts.name: Permission records
src/acl-store.ts.description: Keeps granted, revoked and blocked permissions and storage quotas per napplet build, saved in browser storage.

src/audio-manager.ts.name: Playing audio list
src/audio-manager.ts.description: Tracks which napplet windows are playing audio and notifies the host page's screens when it changes.

src/manifest-cache.ts.name: Verified build hashes
src/manifest-cache.ts.description: Remembers which napplet build hashes were already verified, saved in browser storage.

src/origin-registry.ts.name: Frame directory
src/origin-registry.ts.description: Maps each shell-created frame to its window ID, verified napplet identity and bound message port, and sends replies over that port.

src/session-registry.ts.name: Napplet sessions
src/session-registry.ts.description: Links each window to its verified napplet key both ways and raises a pending update when a napplet's build hash changes.
